description: Application for a Minor Material Amendment (S73.a) to vary condition 2 (approved drawing/document) of planning permission ref: 223365FUL dated 15/02/2023 (as amended by application ref: 233453NMA dated 19.09.2023) for: Conversion of existing building from 2no. flats into 9no. self-contained residential units; single storey, part 2 storey and part 3 storey, side/rear/side (wraparound) extension; creation of balconies and roof terraces to rear elevation; rear roof extension including increase in ridge height; alterations to fenestration; installation of front boundary wall; and provision of associated amenity space, car parking, refuse and cycle storage. Amendment seeks alterations to front lightwell balustrading; insertion of extra rooflight to north flank elevation roof, Juliet balconies and associated glass panels to the upper ground floor windows to the rear elevation; provision of two service risers to either side of the rear elevations; installation of associated hatch to the north flank elevation at lower ground floor level for servicing purposes
